papers.title: Impact of statins and aspirin on tumour response to total neoadjuvant therapy in advanced rectal cancer: A multicentre retrospective cohort study
papers.journal_full: Colorectal disease : the official journal of the Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland
papers.authors: Bedrikovetski S, Lo J, Murshed I, Fitzsimmons T, Nguyen T, Price T
papers.abstract:
AIM: The role of statins and aspirin in modulating tumour response to total neoadjuvant therapy (TNT) in advanced rectal cancer remains unclear. This study evaluates the impact of these medications on overall complete response (oCR) to TNT in patients with advanced rectal cancer.
METHODS: This multicentre, retrospective cohort study included patients with advanced rectal cancer treated with TNT with curative intent at five South Australian hospitals between 2019 and 2026. Medication use (statins and aspirin) was extracted from electronic medical records prior to TNT initiation. The primary outcome was the oCR rate, encompassing clinical complete response (cCR) and pathological complete response (pCR). Secondary outcomes included overall survival (OS), cancer-specific survival (CSS), disease-free survival (DFS) and local recurrence-free survival (LRFS).
RESULTS: Of 360 patients receiving TNT, 95 (26.4%) used statins and 30 (8.3%) used aspirin. No significant differences in oCR rates were observed between statin or aspirin users and non-users (51.9% vs. 40.8%, p = 0.068; 43.3% vs. 43.6%, p = 0.974, respectively). Similarly, no significant differences in cCR or pCR rates were observed for either statin or aspirin use. On logistic regression, achievement of oCR was not significantly associated with statin use (OR, 1.55; 95% CI, 0.97-2.48) or aspirin use (OR, 0.99; 95% CI, 0.47-2.10). Cox regression revealed no significant associations between statin or aspirin use and OS, CSS, DFS or LRFS.
CONCLUSION: Neither statin nor aspirin use was independently associated with improved tumour response to TNT in advanced rectal cancer.

papers.title_zh: 他汀類藥物與阿斯匹靈對進展期直腸癌全程新輔助治療腫瘤反應的影響：多中心回溯性世代研究
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：他汀類藥物與阿斯匹靈在調節進展期直腸癌對全程新輔助治療（TNT）之腫瘤反應方面的角色仍不清楚。本研究評估這些藥物對進展期直腸癌病人接受TNT後整體完全緩解（oCR）的影響。
方法：這項多中心回溯性世代研究納入2019年至2026年間，於南澳洲五家醫院接受根治意圖TNT的進展期直腸癌病人。從電子病歷擷取TNT開始前的用藥情形（他汀類藥物與阿斯匹靈）。主要結果為oCR率，包含臨床完全緩解（cCR）與病理完全緩解（pCR）。次要結果包括整體存活（OS）、癌症特異性存活（CSS）、無病存活（DFS）及無局部復發存活（LRFS）。
結果：360名接受TNT的病人中，95名（26.4%）使用他汀類藥物，30名（8.3%）使用阿斯匹靈。他汀類藥物或阿斯匹靈使用者與未使用者之間的oCR率皆無顯著差異（分別為51.9%對40.8%，p＝0.068；43.3%對43.6%，p＝0.974）。同樣地，無論使用他汀類藥物或阿斯匹靈，cCR或pCR率皆未觀察到顯著差異。邏輯斯迴歸分析顯示，達成oCR與使用他汀類藥物（OR＝1.55；95% CI，0.97–2.48）或阿斯匹靈（OR＝0.99；95% CI，0.47–2.10）皆無顯著關聯。Cox迴歸分析顯示，他汀類藥物或阿斯匹靈的使用與OS、CSS、DFS或LRFS皆無顯著關聯。
結論：他汀類藥物與阿斯匹靈的使用，均未與進展期直腸癌接受TNT後腫瘤反應改善呈現獨立關聯。

papers.title: Primary sclerosing cholangitis: epidemiology, risk factors, pathophysiology, clinical features, diagnosis, and management
papers.authors: Song J, Wang B, Yang T, Zhao Z, Liu Y, Ma X
papers.abstract: Primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) is a rare cholangiopathy characterized by multifocal inflammation and fibrostenotic remodeling of the bile ducts, cholestasis, and increased risks of cholangiocarcinoma and colorectal cancer. No pharmacological therapy has yet improved transplant-free survival. Clinical care therefore depends on accurate phenotyping, surveillance, treatment of biliary and intestinal complications, and timely liver transplantation. Population-based and clinical studies define the epidemiology, risk factors, presentation, diagnosis, and management of PSC. Studies of human biospecimens, including microbiome and metabolomic analyses, describe biological changes associated with the disease, whereas organoid and animal models are used to investigate potential mechanisms. The available evidence links genetic susceptibility and PSC-associated inflammatory bowel disease to cholangiocyte injury, immune activation, disturbed bile acid homeostasis, and microbial alterations. At the bile duct interface, cholangiocyte senescence and barrier dysfunction may interact with microbial exposure and immune-cell recruitment to promote periductal fibrosis. PSC is therefore more plausibly viewed as a multicellular process than as the consequence of a single microbial, immune, or bile acid pathway. Whether dysbiosis and altered bile acid profiles contribute to disease development or instead reflect established PSC remains unresolved. Concomitant inflammatory bowel disease, medication use, biliary obstruction, and previous biliary interventions further complicate causal inference. Longitudinal human studies may distinguish early drivers from secondary changes. Mechanistic findings should ultimately improve patient phenotyping, surveillance, endoscopic management, and selection for targeted trials. Such trials will require biologically informed designs and endpoints that capture durable clinical benefit.

papers.title_zh: 原發性硬化性膽管炎：流行病學、危險因子、病理生理、臨床表現、診斷與處置
papers.abstract_zh: 原發性硬化性膽管炎（PSC）是一種罕見膽管疾病，其特徵為膽管多灶性發炎與纖維狹窄性重塑、膽汁鬱積，以及膽管癌與大腸直腸癌風險增加。目前尚無藥物治療能改善免肝臟移植存活。因此，臨床照護仰賴精確的表型分類、監測、膽道與腸道併發症的治療，以及適時進行肝臟移植。以族群為基礎的研究與臨床研究，界定了PSC的流行病學、危險因子、臨床表現、診斷與處置。人類生物檢體研究，包括微生物群與代謝體分析，描述了與疾病相關的生物學變化；類器官與動物模型則用於探究可能的機轉。現有證據將遺傳易感性及PSC相關發炎性腸道疾病，與膽管上皮細胞損傷、免疫活化、膽酸恆定失衡及微生物變化連結起來。在膽管交界處，膽管上皮細胞老化與屏障功能障礙，可能與微生物暴露及免疫細胞募集交互作用，促進膽管周圍纖維化。因此，將PSC視為多細胞參與的過程，比視為單一微生物、免疫或膽酸路徑所造成的結果更為合理。微生物群失衡及膽酸組成改變究竟促成疾病發生，或只是反映已形成的PSC，目前仍未釐清。共存的發炎性腸道疾病、藥物使用、膽道阻塞，以及既往膽道介入處置，進一步增加了因果推論的複雜性。人類縱向研究或可區分早期驅動因素與次發性變化。機轉研究的發現最終應能改善患者表型分類、監測、內視鏡處置，以及標靶治療試驗的收案選擇。此類試驗將需要以生物學知識為基礎的設計，以及能反映持久臨床效益的終點。

papers.title: B cell-macrophage interactions in colorectal cancer: state coupling, spatiotemporal remodeling, and therapeutic implications
papers.authors: Zhang Z, Zhang Y, Lin J, Cheng B
papers.abstract: The immune microenvironment of colorectal cancer (CRC) is characterized by pronounced cellular-state and spatial heterogeneity. B cells and macrophages bridge adaptive and innate immunity, respectively, and engage in bidirectional regulation through antibodies and immune complexes, BAFF/APRIL signaling, cytokines, chemokines, and metabolic cues. These interactions are further shaped by tumor cells, stromal components, microorganisms, and other immune populations within the tumor microenvironment. From the perspective of B cell-macrophage state coupling, this review systematically summarizes the biological foundations and reciprocal communication mechanisms underlying their interactions, with particular emphasis on their dynamic remodeling across different disease stages, tertiary lymphoid structures, distinct spatial niches within tumors, and metastatic progression. We further evaluate how established therapies and emerging experimental interventions influence this cellular network. Current evidence suggests that specific B-cell and macrophage states may form distinct functional combinations within either immune-supportive or immunosuppressive ecosystems. However, direct causal evidence remains limited, and the reproducibility of these associations across independent patient cohorts has yet to be firmly established. Future studies should integrate single-cell sequencing, B-cell receptor clonotype tracking, spatial multi-omics, and functional perturbation approaches to move beyond cellular co-occurrence and computationally inferred communication toward direct validation of functional dependencies. Such efforts will also be essential for determining whether composite state-spatial signatures can improve patient stratification, therapeutic response prediction, and treatment decision-making.

papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌中的B細胞與巨噬細胞交互作用：狀態耦合、時空重塑與治療意涵
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）的免疫微環境具有顯著的細胞狀態與空間異質性。B細胞與巨噬細胞分別銜接適應性與先天性免疫，並透過抗體與免疫複合體、BAFF/APRIL訊息傳遞、細胞激素、趨化激素及代謝訊號進行雙向調控。這些交互作用進一步受到腫瘤微環境中的腫瘤細胞、基質成分、微生物及其他免疫細胞族群所形塑。本綜述從B細胞與巨噬細胞狀態耦合的角度，系統性整理其交互作用的生物學基礎與雙向溝通機制，特別著重於不同疾病階段、三級淋巴結構、腫瘤內不同空間生態位，以及轉移進程中的動態重塑。我們進一步評估既有療法與新興實驗性介入如何影響此細胞網絡。目前證據顯示，特定的B細胞與巨噬細胞狀態，可能在支持免疫或抑制免疫的生態系統中形成不同的功能組合。然而，直接因果證據仍然有限，而且這些關聯在獨立病人世代間的可重現性，尚未獲得確立。未來研究應整合單細胞定序、B細胞受體克隆型追蹤、空間多體學及功能性擾動方法，以超越細胞共同出現與電腦推論的細胞溝通，進而直接驗證功能上的相依關係。這些努力也將是判定複合狀態－空間特徵能否改善病人分層、治療反應預測與治療決策的關鍵。

papers.title: Early histological remission and prognosis in inflammatory bowel disease: a nationwide cohort study
papers.authors: Mårild K, Söderling J, Axelrad J, Halfvarson J, Sun J, Forss A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND & AIMS: Early remission in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is increasingly recognized for providing long-term prognostic benefits, despite limited supporting data. We examined the prognostic value of histological remission within 12 months of diagnosis.
METHODS: A nationwide cohort study of 14 019 Swedish IBD patients diagnosed in 1990-2022. These patients underwent ileo-colorectal biopsies showing histological remission or inflammation within 1-<12 months post-diagnosis. We estimated adjusted hazard ratios (aHRs) for treatment failure (IBD-related surgery, hospitalization, third corticosteroid dispensation, or second-line advanced therapies), colorectal cancer (CRC), and death until 2023. We adjusted for sociodemographic characteristics, comorbidities, IBD phenotype, and medication history.
RESULTS: Early histological remission was more prevalent in patients with higher educational attainment or those diagnosed since 2000, but less common in childhood-onset (<18 years) and elderly-onset (≥60 years) IBD. Average follow-up extended to 13.7 years. Compared to early remission, histological inflammation within 12 months was linked to an increased risk of treatment failure (aHR = 1.47, 95% CI = 1.39-1.54), particularly hospitalization (aHR = 1.46, 95% CI = 1.39-1.54) and second-line advanced therapy (aHR = 1.60, 95% CI = 1.34-1.91). Histological inflammation (vs early remission) was also linked to a heightened CRC risk (aHR = 1.65, 95% CI = 1.21-2.24), with similar risks in Crohn's disease (CD: aHR = 1.66, 95% CI = 0.94-2.93) and ulcerative colitis (UC: aHR = 1.77, 95% CI = 1.20-2.60). Mortality risk was elevated in CD (aHR = 1.21, 95% CI = 1.01-1.45) but not UC (aHR = 0.96, 95% CI = 0.85-1.08). Associations were similar for corticosteroid-free histological remission within 6 and 12 months.
CONCLUSIONS: Sustained histological inflammation (vs remission) 12 months after IBD diagnosis predicted a higher risk of treatment failure and CRC, indicating that early histological remission may improve long-term disease prognosis.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景與目的：儘管支持資料有限，發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）的早期緩解能帶來長期預後益處，已日益受到重視。我們檢視診斷後12個月內達到組織學緩解的預後價值。
方法：這項全國性世代研究納入14,019名於1990至2022年間確診的瑞典IBD患者。這些患者在診斷後1至未滿12個月內接受迴腸及大腸直腸切片，結果顯示組織學緩解或發炎。我們追蹤至2023年，估計治療失敗（IBD相關手術、住院、第3次皮質類固醇調劑，或使用第二線進階治療）、大腸直腸癌（CRC）與死亡的校正風險比（aHR）。校正變項包括社會人口學特徵、共病、IBD表型與用藥史。
結果：教育程度較高或於2000年起確診的患者，較常出現早期組織學緩解；兒童期發病（<18歲）及老年發病（≥60歲）的IBD患者則較少出現。平均追蹤時間達13.7年。相較於早期緩解，12個月內的組織學發炎與較高的治療失敗風險相關（aHR = 1.47，95% CI = 1.39–1.54），尤其是住院（aHR = 1.46，95% CI = 1.39–1.54）及第二線進階治療（aHR = 1.60，95% CI = 1.34–1.91）。組織學發炎相較於早期緩解，也與較高的CRC風險相關（aHR = 1.65，95% CI = 1.21–2.24）；克隆氏症（CD：aHR = 1.66，95% CI = 0.94–2.93）與潰瘍性結腸炎（UC：aHR = 1.77，95% CI = 1.20–2.60）的風險估計相近。CD患者的死亡風險升高（aHR = 1.21，95% CI = 1.01–1.45），但UC患者並未升高（aHR = 0.96，95% CI = 0.85–1.08）。以6個月及12個月內不使用皮質類固醇的組織學緩解進行分析，所見關聯相似。
結論：IBD確診後12個月持續存在組織學發炎，相較於緩解，可預測較高的治療失敗與CRC風險，顯示早期組織學緩解可能改善長期疾病預後。

papers.title: Association of past colorectal cancer screening with family history of cancer and behavioral factors in Quito, Ecuador: a mixed methods study
papers.authors: Luque J, Callejas G, Polanco N, Andrade P, Ruiz S
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: In Latin America, colorectal cancer is the third most common cancer among men and fourth most common cancer among women. Ecuador has experienced an upward trend in CRC incidence and mortality, highlighting the need to strengthen population-based prevention and early detection strategies. Previous studies in Ecuador recommended more comprehensive evaluations of CRC screening reach, effectiveness, and continuity of care.
METHODS: The study used an explanatory sequential mixed methods research design and collected data using quantitative surveys and individual interviews to explore perceived barriers and facilitators to CRC screening in Quito, Ecuador. For the survey data, bivariate analyses were performed to compare differences on CRC screening history (1 = yes; 2 = no). Categorical variables were compared using chi-square tests, and continuous variables, including scale variables, were compared using two sample t-tests. Independent variables based on previous work and that were identified to be related to CRC screening history in the bivariate analysis were then entered into a multivariable logistic regression model. Qualitative interview participants were asked about perceived causes of CRC, ways to reduce risk, the appropriate age to begin screening, and what types of CRC screening they had heard about or undergone. Content analysis was used to code the transcripts and generate themes from the interviews. Quantitative and qualitative findings were integrated at several stages.
RESULTS: Bivariate analysis showed that individuals who had undergone screening had higher scores on negative beliefs about cancer (11.11 vs. 9.90; p=.03). CRC screening self-efficacy remained a significant independent variable in the multivariable model, showing that lower self-efficacy was associated with a lower probability of screening uptake (OR = 0.78; 95% CI: 0.61-0.99; p=.04). Qualitative analysis revealed that participants were unsure about the criteria for screening, the appropriate age to begin testing, and the differences between available screening tests. Some participants mentioned receiving CRC screening information through their healthcare providers, but they generally perceived public communication about the topic as limited.
CONCLUSIONS: One finding from the study identified opportunities for stool-based testing during annual physical exams. The study also identified opportunities for improved communication in partnership with providers and patients to increase awareness of CRC prevention.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：在拉丁美洲，大腸直腸癌是男性第三常見、女性第四常見的癌症。厄瓜多的大腸直腸癌（CRC）發生率與死亡率呈上升趨勢，凸顯強化以人口為基礎之預防與早期偵測策略的必要性。厄瓜多先前的研究建議，應更全面評估CRC篩檢的觸及程度、有效性及照護連續性。
方法：本研究採解釋型序列式混合方法研究設計，透過量化問卷與個別訪談蒐集資料，探討厄瓜多基多民眾所感知的CRC篩檢障礙與促進因素。針對問卷資料，進行雙變項分析，比較CRC篩檢史（1＝有；2＝無）的差異。類別變項使用卡方檢定比較；連續變項，包括量表變項，則使用雙樣本t檢定比較。接著，將依據既有研究選定、且在雙變項分析中被辨識為與CRC篩檢史相關的自變項，納入多變項邏輯斯迴歸模型。質性訪談詢問參與者所認知的CRC成因、降低風險的方法、適當的篩檢起始年齡，以及曾聽過或接受過哪些CRC篩檢。研究採用內容分析法，對訪談逐字稿進行編碼並歸納主題。量化與質性結果於多個階段進行整合。
結果：雙變項分析顯示，曾接受篩檢者對癌症的負面信念分數較高（11.11 vs. 9.90；p＝.03）。CRC篩檢自我效能在多變項模型中仍是顯著的獨立變項，顯示較低的自我效能與較低的篩檢接受機率相關（OR＝0.78；95% CI：0.61–0.99；p＝.04）。質性分析發現，參與者不確定篩檢條件、適當的檢查起始年齡，以及各種可用篩檢檢查之間的差異。部分參與者提到曾透過醫療照護提供者獲得CRC篩檢資訊，但整體而言，他們認為相關公共溝通有限。
結論：本研究的一項發現指出，可在年度健康檢查期間提供糞便篩檢的機會。研究也指出，可透過與醫療照護提供者及病人合作改善溝通，以提升CRC預防意識。

papers.title: Alternative multiport robotic platforms versus da Vinci in colorectal cancer surgery: a systematic review and platform-stratified meta-analysis
papers.authors: Altamimi A, Alanazi R, Al-Mohy M, Al-Shahrani S, Aldalbahi F, Al Manaa N
papers.abstract: Alternative multiport robotic systems from manufacturers other than Intuitive Surgical are being adopted for colorectal cancer procedures, yet how their outcomes compare with the established da Vinci platform remains unclear. PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, and CENTRAL were searched through August 2026 for randomised trials and comparative observational studies of alternative multiport robots versus da Vinci for colorectal cancer surgery. Random-effects risk ratios (RRs) and mean differences were stratified by platform and resection site; RoB 2, ROBINS-I and GRADE were applied. Twelve studies (one randomised trial; 1,144 participants: 557 alternative platform, 587 da Vinci) evaluated six platforms; hinotori was assessed in six studies and four platforms in one study each. Five cohorts were at serious risk of bias. Console time was 29.38 min longer with alternative platforms (95% CI 17.87 to 40.89; low certainty; mainly hinotori). Total operative time was 20.04 min longer (95% CI 8.81 to 31.28), but heterogeneity and small-study effects made this very uncertain (trim-and-fill estimate 7.24 min, - 4.20 to 18.69). Morbidity estimates were imprecise: Clavien-Dindo grade ≥ II complications RR 1.17 (0.91 to 1.51), grade ≥ III RR 0.86 (0.44 to 1.69), and anastomotic leak RR 1.35 (0.47 to 3.89; 17 events). Certainty was very low for all other outcomes. Alternative multiport robots appear feasible for colorectal cancer surgery but may prolong console time. Their comparative safety and pathological quality relative to da Vinci remain uncertain, and current data do not establish equivalence or non-inferiority. Adequately powered, platform-specific prospective comparisons with predefined non-inferiority margins are required.

papers.abstract_zh: Intuitive Surgical 以外製造商生產的替代性多孔機器人系統，正逐漸應用於大腸直腸癌手術，但其結果與已廣泛使用的 da Vinci 平台相比如何，仍不清楚。本研究搜尋 PubMed、Web of Science、Scopus 及 CENTRAL，納入截至 2026 年 8 月比較替代性多孔機器人與 da Vinci 用於大腸直腸癌手術的隨機試驗及比較性觀察研究。以隨機效應模型估計風險比（RR）與平均差，並依平台及切除部位分層；採用 RoB 2、ROBINS-I 與 GRADE 進行評估。共納入 12 項研究（其中 1 項為隨機試驗；共 1,144 名參與者：替代平台組 557 人、da Vinci 組 587 人），評估 6 種平台；hinotori 有 6 項研究評估，另有 4 種平台各僅有 1 項研究。5 個世代研究具有嚴重偏差風險。替代平台的主控台操作時間較長，平均增加 29.38 分鐘（95% CI 17.87 至 40.89；低確定性；資料主要來自 hinotori）。總手術時間平均增加 20.04 分鐘（95% CI 8.81 至 31.28），但異質性及小型研究效應使此結果非常不確定（剪補法估計為 7.24 分鐘，95% CI −4.20 至 18.69）。併發症估計值不精確：Clavien-Dindo 第 II 級以上併發症 RR 為 1.17（0.91 至 1.51），第 III 級以上併發症 RR 為 0.86（0.44 至 1.69），吻合口滲漏 RR 為 1.35（0.47 至 3.89；17 起事件）。所有其他結果的證據確定性皆為極低。替代性多孔機器人用於大腸直腸癌手術似乎可行，但可能延長主控台操作時間。其相對於 da Vinci 的比較安全性與病理品質仍不確定，目前資料無法確立等效性或非劣性。未來需要具足夠統計檢定力、針對個別平台，且預先設定非劣性界值的前瞻性比較研究。

papers.title: A machine learning model for predicting early adverse outcomes after surgery in patients with early-onset rectal cancer: a two-center retrospective cohort study
papers.authors: Yue X, Zhang G, Cao H, Zhao X, Sun Y, Zhang X
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Patients often present at advanced stages of early-onset rectal cancer (EORC), which is becoming more common. Within a year following rectal resection, some patients experience early adverse outcomes (EAO), such as severe complications, recurrence, or death; however, there is currently no validated postoperative risk-stratification tool for this population. Current prognostic models concentrate on individual endpoints rather than the composite adversity spectrum that is pertinent to younger patients because they were mostly established in older cohorts. This work sought to create and externally validate a model for detecting EORC patients at greater risk of EAO using a stacking ensemble machine learning approach with SHAP interpretability in order to guide individualized postoperative surveillance and adjuvant therapy decisions.
METHODS: In this two-center retrospective cohort study, 648 EORC patients from Center A (2020-2025) constituted the development cohort and 102 patients from Center B (2024-2025) the external validation cohort. Eleven individual machine learning models and a two-layer stacking ensemble (combining three base learners with logistic regression meta-learner) were trained. Model performance was assessed by area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), calibration, and decision curve analysis.
RESULTS: Boruta feature selection identified eleven important predictors, with pathological T stage (pT), lymphovascular invasion (LVI), and pathological TNM stage (pTNM) contributing most to model predictions. The stacking ensemble outperformed all 11 individual models, achieving AUCs of 0.91 (95% CI 0.88-0.93) in the training set, 0.89 (95% CI 0.85-0.94) in the internal validation set, and 0.83 (95% CI 0.76-0.91) in the external validation cohort, with a Brier score of 0.1104 and sustained net benefit on decision curve analysis. An interactive web calculator was deployed for individualized risk assessment.
CONCLUSION: An interpretable stacking ensemble model integrating SHAP analysis and a web-based calculator showed promising predictive performance for EAO following EORC surgery. Designed for postoperative use once pathology data are available, the model provides a comprehensive risk estimate to guide surveillance intensity and interdisciplinary adjuvant therapy decision-making.

papers.title_zh: 預測早發性直腸癌病人術後早期不良結局的機器學習模型：雙中心回溯性世代研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：早發性直腸癌（EORC）日益常見，病人就診時往往已處於較晚期。直腸切除術後一年內，部分病人會發生早期不良結局（EAO），例如嚴重併發症、復發或死亡；然而，目前尚無針對此族群經驗證的術後風險分層工具。現有預後模型大多建立於年長族群，因此著重個別終點，而非與年輕病人相關的複合不良結局範疇。本研究旨在運用具備 SHAP 可解釋性的堆疊集成機器學習方法，建立並外部驗證可辨識 EAO 高風險 EORC 病人的模型，以協助個人化術後追蹤及輔助治療決策。
方法：本雙中心回溯性世代研究納入 A 中心於 2020–2025 年間的 648 名 EORC 病人作為模型開發世代，以及 B 中心於 2024–2025 年間的 102 名病人作為外部驗證世代。研究訓練了 11 種個別機器學習模型，以及一個雙層堆疊集成模型，後者結合三個基礎學習器與邏輯斯迴歸後設學習器。模型表現以接收者操作特徵曲線下面積（AUC）、校準度及決策曲線分析評估。
結果：Boruta 特徵選擇法辨識出 11 項重要預測因子，其中病理 T 分期（pT）、淋巴血管侵犯（LVI）及病理 TNM 分期（pTNM）對模型預測的貢獻最大。堆疊集成模型的表現優於全部 11 種個別模型，在訓練集、內部驗證集及外部驗證世代的 AUC 分別為 0.91（95% CI 0.88–0.93）、0.89（95% CI 0.85–0.94）及 0.83（95% CI 0.76–0.91），Brier 分數為 0.1104，且決策曲線分析顯示持續的淨效益。研究亦部署了互動式網頁計算器，以進行個人化風險評估。
結論：整合 SHAP 分析及網頁計算器的可解釋堆疊集成模型，對 EORC 手術後 EAO 展現具潛力的預測表現。此模型設計於術後病理資料取得後使用，提供綜合風險估計，以協助決定追蹤強度及跨專科輔助治療。

papers.title: The gut microbiota: a key modulator of radiotherapy efficacy and toxicity in colorectal cancer
papers.authors: He X, Yu Y, Wang N, Ma S, Zhang Y, Fang Z
papers.abstract: The gut microbiota plays a critical role in modulating both the efficacy and toxicity of radiotherapy in patients with colorectal cancer (CRC). This review synthesizes current evidence on the bidirectional interaction between the gut microbiome and radiotherapy, highlighting the mechanisms through which microbial communities influence radiosensitivity and treatment-related adverse effects. Specific microbiota-derived metabolites, such as short-chain fatty acids and methylglyoxal, can enhance the radiotherapeutic response by exacerbating DNA damage, promoting immunogenic cell death, and activating antitumor immunity. Conversely, dysbiosis may contribute to radioresistance and exacerbate radiation-induced enteritis by impairing intestinal barrier function and amplifying inflammatory responses. Therapeutic strategies targeting the gut microbiome-including probiotics, prebiotics, antibiotics, and fecal microbiota transplantation-show promise in improving radiotherapy outcomes and mitigating toxicity. However, its clinical application remains limited by issues of safety, variability in individual microbiome composition, and lack of standardized protocols. Further high-quality clinical trials are essential to validate these interventions and advance personalized microbial modulation approaches in CRC radiotherapy.

papers.title_zh: 腸道微生物叢：大腸直腸癌放射治療療效與毒性的關鍵調節因子
papers.abstract_zh: 腸道微生物叢在調節大腸直腸癌（CRC）病人放射治療的療效與毒性方面，扮演關鍵角色。本綜述整合腸道微生物叢與放射治療之間雙向交互作用的現有證據，重點說明微生物群落影響放射敏感性及治療相關不良反應的機轉。特定的微生物叢衍生代謝物，例如短鏈脂肪酸與甲基乙二醛，可藉由加劇 DNA 損傷、促進免疫原性細胞死亡，以及活化抗腫瘤免疫，增強放射治療反應。相反地，菌相失衡可能透過損害腸道屏障功能及放大發炎反應，促成放射抗性並加劇放射性腸炎。針對腸道微生物叢的治療策略，包括益生菌、益生質、抗生素及糞便微生物叢移植，在改善放射治療結果及減輕毒性方面展現潛力。然而，其臨床應用仍受到安全性、個體間微生物叢組成差異，以及缺乏標準化流程等問題的限制。仍須進一步進行高品質臨床試驗，以驗證這些介入措施，並推進 CRC 放射治療中個人化微生物調節策略的發展。

papers.title: From uptake to interface: rethinking molecular imaging of histopathological growth patterns in colorectal cancer liver metastases
papers.authors: Li Q, Kang L, Zhang Z
papers.abstract: Recent work has proposed molecular imaging signatures, including [18F]FDG and fibroblast activation protein inhibitor (FAPI) PET, for the noninvasive characterization of histopathological growth patterns (HGPs) in colorectal cancer liver metastases (CRLM). We suggest that the spatial nature of HGPs warrants further consideration. Because HGPs are defined at the tumor-liver interface and may exhibit intralesional heterogeneity, whole-lesion tracer uptake may not fully capture the complex tumor-host interactions underlying these phenotypes. FAPI uptake may reflect fibroblast-rich stromal remodeling but should not be considered a direct surrogate for desmoplastic HGP. Future imaging-pathology studies could therefore move beyond conventional SUV-based assessment toward spatially resolved, interface-oriented molecular phenotyping. Quantifying tracer uptake and heterogeneity at the tumor-liver interface, together with longitudinal multimodal imaging, may provide complementary information on the dynamic metastatic microenvironment. Prospective studies integrating molecular imaging with standardized HGP assessment and spatially matched histopathology are warranted to determine the clinical value of this approach.

papers.title_zh: 從攝取到界面：重新思考大腸直腸癌肝轉移組織病理生長模式的分子影像
papers.abstract_zh: 近期研究提出以分子影像特徵，包括 [18F]FDG 與纖維母細胞活化蛋白抑制劑（FAPI）PET，非侵入性地描述大腸直腸癌肝轉移（CRLM）的組織病理生長模式（HGPs）。我們認為，HGPs 的空間特性值得進一步考量。由於 HGPs 是依腫瘤—肝臟界面定義，且可能呈現病灶內異質性，整個病灶的示蹤劑攝取可能無法充分反映這些表型背後複雜的腫瘤—宿主交互作用。FAPI 攝取可能反映富含纖維母細胞的間質重塑，但不應視為促結締組織增生型 HGP 的直接替代指標。因此，未來影像—病理研究可超越傳統以標準化攝取值（SUV）為基礎的評估，轉向具空間解析能力、以界面為導向的分子表型分析。量化腫瘤—肝臟界面的示蹤劑攝取及其異質性，並結合縱向多模態影像，可能為動態的轉移微環境提供互補資訊。有必要進行整合分子影像、標準化 HGP 評估，以及空間位置相互對應之組織病理的前瞻性研究，以確定此方法的臨床價值。

papers.title: Weight-loss interventions in gastrointestinal and liver diseases: a narrative review of GLP-1 based therapies, bariatric surgery, and endoscopic approaches
papers.authors: Atieh J, Maselli D, Camilleri M
papers.abstract: Obesity and metabolic dysfunction are increasingly prevalent in patients with diverse gastrointestinal and liver diseases and contribute to disease progression, treatment response, and long-term clinical outcomes. In parallel, the therapeutic landscape for obesity has expanded rapidly, with growing use of incretin receptor agonists (RA), including glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP1)-RA, bariatric surgery, and endoscopic bariatric therapies. Understanding how these weight-loss interventions influence gastrointestinal disease activity, safety, and malignancy risk is essential for clinical decision-making. This narrative review synthesizes current evidence on the effects of obesity as well as weight-loss therapies across a spectrum of gastrointestinal and liver conditions, including metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), gastroesophageal reflux disease, celiac disease, gastrointestinal malignancies, and dumping syndrome. We summarize data from randomized trials, observational cohorts, and meta-analyses evaluating clinical outcomes, disease activity, adverse events, and cancer risk. In MASLD, GLP1-RA and bariatric surgery improve hepatic steatosis and steatohepatitis without aggravation of fibrosis. Fibrosis outcomes are most strongly influenced by sustained weight loss and improvements in insulin resistance. In IBD, obesity (particularly increased visceral fat) may negatively impact response to biologics; however, observational data suggest that GLP1-RA are not associated with increased IBD disease activity and may be associated with favorable clinical outcomes in selected patients with obesity. Bariatric surgery-particularly sleeve gastrectomy-may improve IBD control in carefully selected patients. Data on endoscopic bariatric therapies in IBD are limited but may be effective in selected patients. Gastrointestinal malignancies have increased prevalence in obesity, including esophageal, pancreatic, liver, and colorectal cancers. Current randomized and observational data do not demonstrate consistently increased cancer risk with GLP-1 based therapies, while bariatric surgery may be associated with reduced risk of selected obesity-related cancers. Evidence linking endoscopic bariatric therapies to malignancy risk is currently lacking. Dumping syndrome is a complication of bariatric surgery, but has not been reported following endoscopic bariatric therapies, likely due to delayed gastric emptying. Collectively, weight-loss therapies are increasingly important in the management of gastrointestinal and liver diseases. Ongoing studies and longer-term follow-up are needed to clarify durability of benefit, procedure-specific risks, and optimal patient selection for GLP-1 based therapies.

papers.title_zh: 胃腸與肝臟疾病的減重介入：GLP-1 類療法、減重手術與內視鏡治療之敘述性綜述
papers.abstract_zh: 肥胖與代謝功能障礙在各類胃腸與肝臟疾病病人中日益普遍，並影響疾病進展、治療反應及長期臨床結局。同時，肥胖治療領域迅速擴展，腸泌素受體促效劑（RA），包括類升糖素胜肽-1受體促效劑（GLP1-RA）、減重手術及內視鏡減重治療的使用日益增加。了解這些減重介入如何影響胃腸疾病活動度、安全性與惡性腫瘤風險，對臨床決策至關重要。本敘述性綜述整合目前關於肥胖及減重療法對多種胃腸與肝臟疾病影響的證據，涵蓋代謝功能障礙相關脂肪性肝病（MASLD）、發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）、胃食道逆流疾病、乳糜瀉、胃腸道惡性腫瘤及傾食症候群。我們彙整隨機試驗、觀察性世代研究及統合分析中，評估臨床結局、疾病活動度、不良事件與癌症風險的資料。在 MASLD 中，GLP1-RA 與減重手術可改善肝脂肪變性及脂肪性肝炎，且不使纖維化惡化。纖維化結局主要受持續減重及胰島素阻抗改善所影響。在 IBD 中，肥胖，尤其內臟脂肪增加，可能不利於生物製劑的治療反應；然而，觀察性資料顯示，GLP1-RA 與 IBD 疾病活動度增加無關，且在經篩選的肥胖病人中，可能與較佳臨床結局相關。減重手術，尤其袖狀胃切除術，可能改善經審慎篩選病人的 IBD 控制。IBD 病人接受內視鏡減重治療的資料有限，但此類治療對經篩選的病人可能有效。肥胖族群的胃腸道惡性腫瘤盛行率較高，包括食道癌、胰臟癌、肝癌與大腸直腸癌。目前的隨機與觀察性資料並未一致顯示 GLP-1 類療法會增加癌症風險，而減重手術可能與某些肥胖相關癌症風險降低有關。目前尚缺乏內視鏡減重治療與惡性腫瘤風險關聯的證據。傾食症候群是減重手術的併發症，但內視鏡減重治療後尚未有相關報告，可能是因為胃排空延遲。整體而言，減重療法在胃腸與肝臟疾病管理中的重要性日益增加。仍需進行中的研究及更長期追蹤，以釐清 GLP-1 類療法效益的持久性、各術式特有風險，以及最佳病人選擇。
